description: A head cast from the Stormcaller's drowned bronze on a haft bound with his copper tines and titan iron, beaten at Last Hearth's forge. It rings when it strikes. Struck into a foe standing in water, the ring runs through the water and the blow lands half again as hard.

perk.text: Heavies that strike a foe standing in water land half again as hard (damage and poise)
